The biggest WCA competition of 2024 in Bangladesh, and the 2nd WCA competition of Chattogram city. We hope it will be enjoyable for everybody. Necessary details are provided in the tabs. Still you can  [contact] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChattogramWinterOpen2024#50736-contact) us for any queries. 

**First Time Participants have to bring an ID card with their Date of Birth for identity verification.**

English
It is necessary to read the WCA rules.
The competitor may participate in every event they want.
We ask that you don't subscribe for events that you're not intended to participate.
(*Admission to the public is free*).
